title: Integral matrix kernel with locally free rational cokernel
statement: For a prime ℓ and normed E/Q_ℓ with coefficients [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], a map a:A→B of finite free integral module objects on a scheme X has pro-etale locally finite free kernel whenever Ext(coker(a)) is pro-etale locally finite free. In particular this holds for any standard finite matrix whose rationalization is epi. Local finite freeness means a pro-etale covering on each member of which the pulled module is Mod.IsFree, allowing rank zero.

source.place: Section 6.8, coefficient localization and Lemma 6.8.13, first paragraph; agent intersection/matrix variant

proof.text: Induct on the source rank using integralMatrix_pivot_cover. On a zero piece the kernel is the finite free source. For a nonzero piece, the monic pivot identifies the kernel with the smaller Schur-complement kernel. Scalar extension inverts the pivot, so the smaller matrix has the same locally free rational cokernel. Apply the induction hypothesis at the strictly smaller source rank.

Transport the local freeness through the kernel isomorphisms, undo coefficient normalization, and bind the trivializing covers. The required isomorphism, pullback-composition, and coefficient-restriction lemmas are reused through proof-only import all of CondensedConstructibleSerre.
When the rationalized matrix is epi, exact scalar extension identifies its rational cokernel with zero. The zero module is finite free of rank zero, so the preceding theorem applies.

theorem integralMatrixKernel_locallyFree (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A B : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) (a : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : Mod.IsFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) A)
    (hB : Mod.IsFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) B)
    (hLF : ∃ V : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ k,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).mapMod _).obj
          ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
            (cokernel a)))) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj (kernel a))
